title: `ReservesSetupHelper.configureReserves` does not validate parameter ordering / consistency
impact: The `onlyOwner` guard is present, but the function does not enforce `liquidationThreshold > baseLTV`, `liquidationBonus > 10000`, or that `borrowCap`/`supplyCap` are non-zero when borrowing is enabled. A governance multisig member or a compromised owner can configure an inconsistent reserve (e.g., LTV > liquidation threshold) that makes positions instantly liquidatable or, worse, prevents liquidation entirely. Since this is a batch helper, one bad struct in the array poisons a whole batch.
